Form Card

A composed wrapper for icon + title lead-capture forms — the "Request a Quote" / "Tell us what you're migrating from" pattern. Drop any Input, Select, Textarea or File Upload fields into the slot; the card supplies the frame, heading, submit and footnotes. The card below is live.

3 iconsslot for fieldstitle · subtitle · notesComposed

Preview

Request Your Discounted Quote

Tell us what you're migrating from and we'll do the rest.

  • No obligation to proceed
  • Response within 1 business day

Icons

The icon prop resolves to an inline Font Awesome Free Solid SVG — one of three named icons, tinted with --color-secondary.

Code

          
<FormCard
  icon="quote"
  title="Request Your Discounted Quote"
  submitLabel="Get Your Migration Quote"
  action="/api/quote"
  method="post"
  noteLeft="No obligation to proceed"
  noteRight="Response within 1 business day"
>
  <Input label="First name *" name="firstName" />
  <Input label="Last name *" name="lastName" />
  <Input label="Email address *" name="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
  <Select label="Document library I am replacing" name="library" placeholder="Choose option" options={[...]} />
  <FileUpload name="quoteFile" />
</FormCard>

Guidelines

✓ Do

Start Free Trial

One clear ask per card.

  • Keep one primary action per card — a single submit.
  • Use the subtitle to set expectations, notes to reduce friction.
  • Match the icon to the intent: quote, key or check.
✗ Don't

Sign up · Log in · Learn more

Too many competing asks.

  • Don't stack multiple submits or CTAs in one card.
  • Don't hard-code the pink submit fill — use --color-primary.
  • Don't drop the visible labels on the slotted fields.
